# Photos Archive Exporter v0.1.0

First public build of Photos Archive Exporter.

## Highlights

- Native macOS SwiftUI app.
- Universal app build for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
- Read-only export from the current Apple Photos library using PhotoKit.
- Original resource export for photos, videos, Live Photo paired videos, and RAW/JPEG resources exposed by PhotoKit.
- Year/month/day archive folder layout.
- Capture-time filename prefixing.
- Safe reruns using an archive index.
- Strong duplicate report without deleting duplicates.
- JSON and CSV export reports.

## Download

Download:

```text
PhotosArchiveExporter-v0.1.0-macos-universal.zip
```

Unzip it, then open `Photos Archive Exporter.app`.

This build is ad-hoc signed for local use. If macOS blocks first launch, right-click the app, choose **Open**, and confirm.

## Requirements

- macOS 13 or later
- Originals stored locally in the active Photos library
- Photos permission granted to the app

## Known Limitations

- No automatic iCloud original download management.
- No edited-version export.
- No album/place/person folder organization.
- No pause/cancel controls yet.
- Not notarized for public distribution yet.
